dsh-skin-switcher 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在设置界面新增「皮肤」页，自动发现已安装皮肤并一键切换，支持一键恢复官方默认外观。

posts.en:
dsh-skin-switcher is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a Skins page to Settings that auto-discovers installed skins for one-click switching, with one-click restore to the official default look.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3ac329306b554bb5a1ab.html
